description: Configure Messaging for In-App and Web (MIAW) channels in Service Cloud: Messaging Channel, Embedded Service Deployment, CORS/CSP Trusted Sites, pre-chat fields, session routing by Queue or Omni-Channel Flow, Status-Based capacity, Live Agent migration. Trigger keywords: MessagingChannel, EmbeddedServiceConfig, messagingChannelType, EmbeddedMessaging, sessionHandlerQueue, sessionHandlerFlow, embeddedConfig, automatedResponses, CorsWhitelistOrigin, CspTrustedSite, BrandingSet, MessagingSession, MessagingEndUser, enhanced chat, embedded messaging, chat widget, pre-chat form, auto-response. NOT for an Agentforce agent in the chat window - use agentforce/agent-channel-deployment. NOT for Omni-Channel enablement, Service Channels or skills-based routing - use admin/omni-channel-routing-setup.
inputs: Org edition and Messaging for In-App and Web feature availability confirmation
List of widget domains where the chat button will be embedded
Agent capacity model preference (Tab-Based or Status-Based)
Pre-chat field requirements (fields to collect before session begins)
Name of the Experience site or website the deployment attaches to
Name of the fallback queue and confirmation that it has members
Auto-response text and languages for the initial, inactive and agent-end paths
name: messaging-and-chat-setup
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide (v62 PDF), *MessagingChannel* — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf (required fields `masterLabel` / `messagingChannelType` / `sessionHandlerType` / `sessionHandlerQueue`; the `sessionHandlerQueue`-as-fallback semantics behind the Reliability pillar and anti-pattern 3; `messagingChannelType` enum and the third-party-channel exclusion; `automatedResponses` types and the 5–60 minute `responseTimeoutInMins` range)

Metadata API Developer Guide (v62 PDF), *EmbeddedServiceConfig* and its `embeddedServiceMessagingChannel`, `EmbeddedServiceForm` and `EmbeddedServiceFormField` subtypes — same PDF (required `site` and `masterLabel`; `deploymentFeature` / `deploymentType` enums behind anti-pattern 1; the pre-chat form shape rules and the channel-parameter matching described under Adaptable; the "doesn't support the wildcard character" note behind anti-pattern 5)

Metadata API Developer Guide (v62 PDF), *EmbeddedServiceBranding* and *BrandingSet* — same PDF ("This object works only with the legacy chat products. For Messaging for In-app and Web, use the BrandingSet object", which is anti-pattern 4)

Metadata API Developer Guide (v62 PDF), *CorsWhitelistOrigin* and *CspTrustedSite* — same PDF (HTTP 404 for a non-allowlisted origin, behind the Security pillar and anti-pattern 6; the wildcard-position rule; every `isApplicableTo*Src` defaulting to false and the API 59.0+ at-least-one-directive requirement; the 12 KB CSP header guidance that bounds per-environment registration)

Metadata API Developer Guide (v62 PDF), *ServiceChannel* and *OmniChannelSettings* — same PDF (`capacityModel` `STATUS_BASED` / `TAB_BASED` from API 65.0 and the org-level `enableOmniStatusCapModel`, which is the corrected basis for the Status-Based vs Tab-Based tradeoff below)

Object Reference for Salesforce and Lightning Platform (v62 PDF), *MessagingSession*, *MessagingEndUser* and *ConversationEntry* — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf (`EndUserContactId` field properties behind anti-pattern 2; the `Status` / `Origin` / `AgentType` / `ChannelType` picklists used for verification and monitoring; the note that the on-platform `ConversationEntry` schema covers legacy chat only, which constrains transcript-level reporting design)

Apex Reference Guide (v62 PDF), *RichMessaging Namespace* — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf (the `AuthRequestHandler`, `ProcessFormHandler` and `ProcessPaymentHandler` extension points for enhanced Messaging channels, and the tightened governor limits that apply inside `AuthRequestHandler`: 2 SOQL queries, 1 DML statement, 2 callouts)
Salesforce Well-Architected — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html (Security, Reliability and Adaptable framing used in this file)
outputs: MessagingChannel metadata with routing, embeddedConfig, auto-responses and pre-chat parameters
EmbeddedServiceConfig metadata binding the channel, site, branding set and pre-chat form
BrandingSet for the chat window (not EmbeddedServiceBranding, which is legacy-only)
CorsWhitelistOrigin and CspTrustedSite entries for every widget domain
package.xml naming each EmbeddedServiceConfig explicitly (the type has no wildcard support)
Checker run with no ERROR from scripts/check_messaging_and_chat_setup.py
MessagingSession and MessagingEndUser verification query results from a test conversation
